Mira: Quick heads-up  seven preview seats start Monday. Need owners for kickoffs, a tiny survey, and an auto-flag rule so CSMs can triage early.
Jon: I can take two kickoffs (10am PT, 3pm PT). Slides pls.
Priya: Ill build a 3-question survey: NPS, latency impacted? (y/n), integration blocker? (y/n) + optional freeform. Link draft: https://forms.redwood/preview-mini
Luis: Wire ingestion to kafka://preview.feedback.v1 and tag account_id + cohort=jun2026_preview. Ill run weekly CSV to cs-ops.
Mira: Auto-flag if NPS <=5 OR latency impacted=yes OR integration blocker=yes. Tag=preview-risk. Also flag if they miss enablement twice.
notifier-bot: Reminder scheduled: send survey 24h after kickoff.
Jon: Pushed a short quickstart doc to repo (WIP).
Priya: Survey wired and ingestion tested.
Luis: CSV export ready; includes contact_window column per request.
Mira: Great. Ill calendar a day-3 triage (15m) for any flagged accounts. Post updates here when done. :pray:
